options.name: Church exempt from taxes
options.desc: The Graic Church is exempt from taxation and its priests do not pay income tax.

options.name: Tax cuts for the Church
options.desc: The Church pays a decreased rate of income and property tax, while the priests are charged with a lump sum tax.

options.name: Equal taxation of the Church
options.desc: There are no tax exemptions for the Graic Church. The rates are equal to any other legal person or entrepreneur.
